title: 💗 मीरा ने नीचे से हाथ बढ़ाया, दादी की चप्पल छत पर ही रह गई… #shorts
title_alts: 🤔 क्या मीरा ऊँची खुली सीढ़ियाँ चढ़कर दादी की चप्पल ला पाएगी? #shorts
😰 मीरा के सामने ऊँची खुली सीढ़ियाँ, दिल तेज़, हथेलियाँ ठंडी… #shorts
description_hook: दादी की चप्पल छत पर रह गई और मीरा ने खुद रास्ता निकाला।

characters.name: मीरा
characters.description: six-year-old girl, two braids, green frock, a small black tika on her forehead

characters.name: दादी
characters.description: elderly woman, white saree, round spectacles, a wooden walking stick in her hand

scenes.narration: छह साल की मीरा दादी की चप्पल छत से लाना चाहती थी। दादी सीढ़ियाँ नहीं चढ़ पातीं।
scenes.caption: Six-year-old Meera wanted to bring Grandmother's slipper down from the terrace. Grandmother cannot climb the stairs.
scenes.image_brief: Meera, a six-year-old girl with two braids, a green frock and a small black tika on her forehead, standing at the foot of a wide low concrete staircase and looking up at a single worn slipper on the top step, while an elderly woman in a white saree with round spectacles and a wooden walking stick sits on a low chair nearby. Bright daylight.

scenes.narration: उसने नीचे से हाथ बढ़ाया, पर उँगलियाँ हवा ही छूती रहीं। मेरे साथ बोलो: एक कदम, फिर एक कदम।
scenes.caption: She reached up from below, but her fingers touched only air. Say with me: one step, then one step.
scenes.image_brief: Meera standing on the lowest step with one arm stretched upward towards the slipper on the top step, her fingers well short of it, bright midday light on the concrete.

scenes.narration: दो सीढ़ी चढ़कर उसने चप्पल छुई, पर वह खिसककर पीछे गिर पड़ी। दादी के पास बस एक ही जोड़ी थी।
scenes.caption: Two steps up she touched the slipper, but it slid back out of reach. Grandmother had only one pair.
scenes.image_brief: The worn slipper slid backwards and lying flat further along the top landing, beyond arm's reach, with Meera standing two steps up holding the side wall with one hand and looking at it. Warm daylight.

scenes.narration: मीरा छाता ले आई। उसे उलटा पकड़कर मुड़े हत्थे में चप्पल फँसाई और बोली: एक कदम, फिर एक कदम।
scenes.caption: Meera fetched the umbrella. She held it upside down, hooked the slipper in the curved handle, and said: one step, then one step.
scenes.image_brief: Meera standing two steps up holding a closed black umbrella upside down, its curved wooden handle hooked around the strap of the slipper on the landing above, her face careful and pleased. Warm afternoon light on the concrete.

scenes.narration: चप्पल एक-एक सीढ़ी नीचे उतरी। मीरा ने उसे दादी के पैरों के पास रखा। क्या तुम भी सीढ़ियाँ गिनोगे?
scenes.caption: The slipper came down one stair at a time. Meera set it beside Grandmother's feet. Will you count the stairs too?
scenes.image_brief: Meera crouching at the bottom of the stairs to place the worn slipper beside the feet of the elderly woman in the white saree seated on her low chair, the closed umbrella lying on the step behind her, both smiling. Soft light.

scenes.narration: दादी चप्पल पहनकर आँगन तक चलीं, और मीरा का मन नाच उठा। एक कदम, फिर एक कदम।
scenes.caption: Grandmother walked out to the courtyard in her slippers, and Meera's heart danced. One step, then one step.
scenes.image_brief: The elderly woman in the white saree walking out into the sunlit courtyard in both her slippers with her wooden stick, while Meera sits on the bottom step watching her go with her hands in her lap, evening light through the doorway.
